The test image displays a mango leaf with widespread black, superficial fungal growth, characteristic of Sooty Mould. This mould grows on the honeydew excreted by sucking insects. The reference images for Sooty Mould all show this same characteristic black coating on the leaves, strongly matching the test image. The other classes are visually distinct. Anthracnose typically presents as dark, sunken lesions; Powdery Mildew is a white, dusty coating; and Die Back affects twigs and branches, not just the leaves in this manner. The visual evidence from the reference images confirms the initial diagnosis based on the test image's features.
